description: Return the first Portuguese public holiday on or after a date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today in Lisbon), for the whole country or for one municipality.

municipality.description: Optional municipality (concelho), e.g. "Lisboa" or "Evora"; accents optional. Adds its municipal holiday and, in the Azores or Madeira, the regional ones. Without it, only national holidays.
